title: S&P DJI December quarterly rebalance — pro-forma files and the S&P 500/100/400/600 constituent announcement, after the close
source: EST: derived from S&P DJI's published Equity Indices Policies & Practices rule plus this cycle's own three-for-three 2026 precedent, all of it re-checked 2026-09-08. THE RULE: pro-forma files for float-adjusted market-cap-weighted indices are released after the market close on the FIRST FRIDAY, TWO WEEKS PRIOR to the rebalancing effective date (the capped and alternatively weighted files follow one week later), as recorded and cited by the sibling ledger sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-09-04.md leg 1. THE ARITHMETIC: December 2026's Fridays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th, so the third Friday is 2026-12-18 — already tracked here as opex-2026-12-18 on a confirmed OCC prefix — the effective open is Monday 2026-12-21, and the first Friday two weeks prior is 2026-12-04. THE PRECEDENT, now three for three inside 2026: the March changes were announced Friday 2026-03-06, the June changes Friday 2026-06-05, and the September changes Friday 2026-09-04 — the last of these read direct from the owner's own newsroom by this session (press.spglobal.com, HTTP 200, date-stamped "Sep 4, 2026"), each a first Friday exactly two weeks ahead of a third-Friday effective date. Filed estimate on three counts: no S&P DJI document published for December 2026 was fetched this session (the owner's index-announcements page at spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/index-news-and-announcements/ returned HTTP 403 to this runner, recorded in the proposing ledger's probe-ref.blocked rather than silently substituted), the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published schedule, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it derived in-sweep. Proposed by the sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21 initial research, 2026-09-08
notes: WHY THIS MILESTONE AND NOT THE OTHER TWO. The proposing research measured the S&P quarterly rebalance and found the effect is at the ANNOUNCEMENT, not at the effective date. At index level the effective open is a null (SPY, Monday after the third Friday, 2005-2026: 40 of 83 negative across the four quarterly legs, sign p=82.6%; no relative-volume step). At constituent level the announcement-reaction session is not: on 2026-09-08, measured intraday, 28 of 32 named companies moved in the direction their index action predicts (sign p=0.002%), and the S&P SmallCap 600 cohort was perfect at 12 of 12 — 5 additions +6.47% mean excess against IJR, 7 clean-exit deletions -2.97%, a 9.44pp spread, on 2.5-3.0x relative turnover — while S&P 500 additions excluding the contaminated Bloom Energy managed +0.49%. So the December date worth carrying on the board is the one where the roster becomes public. TWO SIBLING MILESTONES WERE DELIBERATELY NOT PROPOSED, recorded here so a later lane does not re-litigate them: the capped/alternatively-weighted pro-forma (2026-12-11 by the same rule, the December twin of the tracked sp-rebalance-proforma-capped-2026-09-11) and the December effective open (2026-12-21, this proposer's own December twin). Both are derivable from the identical rule and neither was filed, because this research measured the effective date as an index-level null and the capped file as a non-event — filing them would spend board attention on nothing, the same call the russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2026-09-21 lane made about its own next instance. WHAT MAKES THE DECEMBER CYCLE DIFFERENT FROM SEPTEMBER'S, and the reason it is worth one board slot rather than zero: 2026-12-04 is also a jobs print (jobs-2026-12-04, already tracked), the release lands into the year's heaviest tax-loss-harvesting window, and the effective open 2026-12-21 stacks on the 2026-12-18 quad-witching close exactly as September's does — so it is the one instance where a measured announcement effect and a dense macro corridor can be separated by having both legs on the board in advance. Impact low, symbols deliberately empty: the flow lives in the individual names named on the day, which are unknowable three months out, and an ETF proxy would only make the deterministic screen trip on broad-market beta. Kind 'sector' matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; the enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named rather than fixed from this lane.
